It states 'DRAFT CONTROL ANCHOR UPDATES — prepare (no write)' and 'No write has been executed; these await review before application' and 'draft_writes_executed: 0'. Instead of editing the supplied Draft's PM attention and Problems and inefficiencies anchors, it prepares values for non-standard anchor names (cmt_pipeline.control_status, cmt_pipeline.chase_proposals, cmt_pipeline.effort_variance, cmt_pipeline.risk_flags, cmt_pipeline.healthy_items) that do not match the Draft's actual anchor structure. result.reason: The candidate meets all six assertions. It uses only collector snapshot IDs with no provider call, explicitly calculates 4 days overdue and 6 days stale from local_day 2026-08-24 with the full (10-6) x MYR 90 = MYR 360 formula basis, directly updates only PM attention and Problems and inefficiencies in the supplied Draft (incrementing draft_version, preserving Decisions/SOPs untouched), produces exactly one approved Telegram eval-route proposal for PERSON-AISHA in prepare mode with no send claim, fully suppresses TASK-109, and leaves Decisions/SOPs/Project memory/final reports untouched. The baseline fails three core assertions: it does not directly update the Draft at all (draft_writes_executed: 0, uses non-standard anchor names instead of PM attention/Problems and inefficiencies), produces no Telegram eval-route proposal for PERSON-AISHA (only Notion comment proposals), and does not explicitly preserve the (10-6) x MYR 90 = MYR 360 basis formula. The baseline correctly detects stale/blocked work and suppresses TASK-109 from Draft/outreach, but it is materially incomplete as a deliverable — two of the task's primary outputs (direct Draft update and approved Telegram proposal) are entirely absent.
